method: Independent static review of journal/identity/coordinator and worker assembly, plus stdlib SHA256 and SELECT-only SQLite mode=ro artifact checks. No tests, application imports, SDK/OpenD, sockets or source changes during this review. Earlier owned codec tests are separately identified evidence.

current_validation.scope: Only fullgate-terminal-r2 and actual-protobuf/run-r3-final establish the final frozen input result.

actual_loading_scope.union_definition: Final run parent result/guard-final plus all first/recovery actual_loader proofs. Source maps counted separately; package union includes loaded_package_sha256 and protobuf_bindings.loaded_files. Every listed file independently rehashed.
actual_loading_scope.bootstrap: Unchanged original verified protobuf loader with finite hash-checked application preload while google/futu/pb2 cold; private-only path restored for loader. Exact TestWorkerSpec commands/env and original serve/supervisor.
actual_loading_scope.io_scope: Only parent-owned 127.0.0.1 dynamic listeners, never 11111; child exact endpoint, no SDK top-level import/DNS/external endpoint/subprocess/thread. Recorded forbidden attempt counters zero.

independently_checked_chain: Every emitted original ACTION request hash/length matches actual owned-peer bytes and private request frame; every typed fact response matches peer and private response bytes, original ACTION receipt, request frame, protocol and session.

Six init/query references in submit bundle match original events. CLAIM and submit ACTION contain the same bundle. Independently reconstructing canonical acknowledged identity from original submit/CLAIM/ACK event JSON reproduces each first-worker adopted identity ID exactly.

Each followup ACTION is later than the persisted original ACK, contains its opaque orderIDEx and matches the prebound frame. Test registry supplies original request bytes/permit times only; original journal remains the sole business record and identity source.

Positive final case: None to original persisted ACK identity, 2201 cumulative partial observation, 2205 cancel ACK, second 2201 CANCELLED_PART observation; 12 ACTIONs, 10 request/response frames, two connections. No OBSERVATION/economic reconciliation event.

Twelve original IDs replay through original worker with no new request encoding, adoption, connection or send. Recovery codec initial/final broker ID and accepted identity remain None; frozen tests assert database/registry bytes and peer counts unchanged; retained report has io_order=[] and socket_connect=0.

Shared stop after ACK retains original identity and prevents a fresh followup ACTION/send. Foreign order response remains in private raw frames, produces no matched trade_observe fact and does not replace original identity.

Confirmed quote-loss is explicit test fault injection: the owned socket descriptor becomes -1 and live markers are cleared while accepted identity remains intact. Peer observes quote EOF before checked trade results; original trade query/cancel succeed, two connections total, no quote reconnect. This does not prove a production FIN detector.

Submit/cancel ACKs remain nonterminal financial evidence. 2201 cumulative quantity/average are retained; exact notional/fees/fee-final remain unknown. Cash=100 is the explicitly independent fixture snapshot. No reserve release is inferred from ACK or these facts.
Fictional key/IV/retMsg markers remain in private original handshake evidence; none appears in typed journal. All typed permissions remain false and source_authenticated false.
static_contract_review: read_acknowledged_order follows complete hash/result-checked journal replay. Canonical original ACK facts must be the submit outcome evidence ID and original response receipt disposition ACKNOWLEDGED; missing facts and bare OUTCOME do not mint identity; conflicting ACK/ownership is rejected.

Identity derives from original submit/ACK events rather than latest head, claim state, filled amounts or fees. Matching reprojection and later observe/cancel do not change it; unrelated reconciliation and unknown fees do not hide original identity.

New v3 followup admission is in _write after BEGIN IMMEDIATE/full _load and after original request replay returns, before control barriers. Historical _reduce remains compatible. The frozen 14996-byte base-1f04c393 ACTION fixture checks old read/replay and denies a new unproved followup.

Coordinator only adopts after confirmed response save and full readback matching this submit operation/facts ID. Save failure, including commit-then-lost-reply, does not adopt or retry. Same original typed identity is idempotent.

Every fresh followup reads current journal identity outside barriers. Barrier checks compare cached typed identity, exact operation order ID and original accepted sessions without DB access or lock inversion.

Final _order_session requires current trade connection/initialization and original dual accepted session equality. It does not require quote liveness. _submit_session still requires both live channels; trade loss remains denied.

time_bounds.observed_channel_span_definition: First init transport started_monotonic to last transport finished_monotonic per channel; every final case is below 30 seconds.

legacy_before_quote_loss.scope: Retained successful prior inputs; not upgraded to final-source proof and not added to four-case final coverage.
legacy_before_quote_loss.reason_for_new_input: Remove unnecessary quote-live coupling after original order ACK; add explicit confirmed quote-loss evidence and retain trade-live refusal.

limitations: W4 current source assembled with read-only r7 private runtime and actual generated protobuf; every broker/market/order/cash value is synthetic. No OpenD, real/simulated broker account, external source authentication or model call.

No production PackageWorkerSpec/bootstrap, account authorization, source freshness, lawful tick/lot rule, fee schedule or installation acceptance is established; all existing production gates remain closed.
2201 cumulative order fields are not 2211 individual fills; no 2211 or 2225 request occurred in these actual cases. Numeric orderID does not replace opaque original orderIDEx.
Confirmed quote-loss recovery is explicitly injected, including a real owned socket close. Production automatic FIN detection and automatic reconnect are not implemented or claimed.
Recovery constructs unused synthetic response objects; the precise guarantee is no new request encoding, identity adoption or IO, not no serialization whatsoever.
Final source assertions are bound to the ten hashes above. Old successful tests remain separate evidence, and neither loaded-file closure nor input manifest is whole-package or end-user acceptance.
